question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or bridge existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The missing work is bounded in code, but it creates public persisted session and Gateway/tool contract fields whose semantics must be stable before implementation.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Align With Resolver Lineage First
options.body: Keep this issue open until sessions.resolve/family lineage semantics are settled, then align spawned-session chain metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling or docs if maintainers do not want a new persisted chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.
